# EdgeOne Makers Models Provider

> Vercel AI SDK Provider for EdgeOne Makers Models

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@edgeone/makers-models-provider.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@edgeone/makers-models-provider)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

A lightweight provider for using EdgeOne Makers Models with the Vercel AI SDK.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @edgeone/makers-models-provider ai
```

## Quick Start

```typescript
import { createAiGateway } from '@edgeone/makers-models-provider';
import { generateText } from 'ai';

const aigateway = createAiGateway({
  apiKey: process.env.MAKERS_MODELS_KEY,
});

const result = await generateText({
  model: aigateway('@makers/<model>'),
  prompt: 'What is TypeScript?',
});

console.log(result.text);
```

## Documentation

For setup guides, current model identifiers, supported providers, and examples, see the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/TencentEdgeOne/makers-models-provider).
